run_semantic_segmentation_inference: run semantic segmentation inference on images using a trained encoder-decoder model with multiscale testing
test_segmentation_module: test a segmentation module by running forward passes on a dataloader and saving visualized results
visualize_segmentation_result: visualize segmentation predictions by color-encoding labels and concatenating with the original image
build_segmentation_network: build a segmentation network with a configurable encoder and decoder architecture using ModelBuilder
create_test_dataset_loader: create a test dataset and dataloader for inference on a list of images or a directory of images
